name: appactor-capacitor
description: AppActor Capacitor SDK — server-authoritative in-app purchases, subscriptions, offerings, remote config and experiments for iOS and Android.
author: AppActor <dev@appactor.com> (https://appactor.com)

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:web && npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android
scripts.verify:web: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:ios: xcodebuild -scheme AppactorCapacitor -destination generic/platform=iOS -quiet && xcodebuild test -scheme AppactorCapacitor -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}" -quiet
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
